text:
morgan: quick ping 1: can we add a tiny "insightlet" in the rollout row that surfaces recent fallback examples + a one-line reason? ops want fast triage without opening the full audit.
arya: good idea. what should the insightlet contain? my thought: reason (coarse), count in last hour, top affected customers, and a quick link to play a sampled example.
devin: keep it compact: [reason: latency] [hits: 42/hr] [top-cust: acme.co] [play]. clicking play should open a small side panel with primary vs fallback diff and a quality score.
srinivas: implementationally, the insightlet should read from a 5m rolling window metric to avoid heavy DB queries. store a small cache of the last 10 sampled tokens per rollout for the panel.
cam: UX: make the insightlet collapsible and allow operators to pin it open. also add a tiny color indicator (green/yellow/red) based on severity thresholds.
morgan: for telemetry name the metric fallback_insight_summary and include fields: rollout_id, window_start_ts, reason_top, hits_count, sample_token. keep it flat and small.
arya: security: sample_token resolves to a redacted preview only; full sample behind gated audit. don't leak prompt texts in the insightlet.
devin: billing note: show a small estimated cost impact on hover (normalized units) so PMs can see econ impact quickly. cam: love it.
srinivas: i'll sketch the cache + resolution API. can we ship the UI with read-only insightlets behind a feature flag for 2 weeks? morgan: yes, feature flag on staging tomorrow.
morgan: thanks all, i'll post mock and a short PR with telemetry names.
